get.description:
Return the state of everything monitored, as of now or an earlier moment.

The present is rounded down to the polling interval, and each moment
is served from one cached, already compressed copy.

Return the problems in the state as of now or an earlier moment,
with the maintenance that accounts for each, who is on it, the team
that owns it, and where its page stands.

Pass the ``generated_at`` of the state being shown, so the two match.

post.description: Return what failing some devices, sites, and links would do.

get.description: Return the changes the source saw over its whole history.
Return one device's readings over the source's whole history.

schema.title: Response List Windows Api Maintenance Get

post.description: Acknowledge a problem there is now, with a note.

get.description:
Return who is on call for every team, now or at an earlier moment,
and how to reach them and the carriers.
Return the team that owns each site, device, and link.

post.description:
Page the team that owns a problem there is now.

Nothing is sent: the page is recorded, and escalates on paper.
Put someone on call in place of a team's primary for a while.

get.description: List saved layouts, most recently saved first.

schema.title: Response List Layouts Api Layouts Get

put.description: Save a layout, replacing any with the same name.

Carrier.title: Carrier
Carrier.description: How to reach a carrier's NOC about its circuits.

Circuit.title: Circuit
Circuit.description: A carrier circuit carrying a WAN link.

CoverIn.title: CoverIn
CoverIn.description: Someone taking a team's primary turn for a while.

Device.title: Device
Device.description: A network device at one site.

DeviceCenter.title: DeviceCenter
DeviceCenter.description: A neighborhood built around one device.

DeviceHistory.title: DeviceHistory
DeviceHistory.description:
One device's readings at regular steps, oldest first.

Step ``i`` is at ``start + i * step_s``. Values are None where there was
no fresh reading: the device was down, cut off, or not reporting.

DeviceState.title: DeviceState
DeviceState.description: Whether a monitored device answers, and how quickly.

Endpoint.title: Endpoint
Endpoint.description: One end of a link: a device's interface, optionally a LAG member.

EventLog.title: EventLog
EventLog.description: The changes seen between two moments, oldest first.

Impact.title: Impact
Impact.description: What some failures do to the network.

InterfaceHistory.title: InterfaceHistory
InterfaceHistory.description: One interface's readings at each step of a device history.

InterfaceState.title: InterfaceState
InterfaceState.description: A monitored interface's status and load, as a share of its speed.

LayoutIn.title: LayoutIn
LayoutIn.description: A layout as the browser sends it.

LayoutSettings.title: LayoutSettings
LayoutSettings.description: The topology view's settings when the layout was saved.

LayoutSummary.title: LayoutSummary
LayoutSummary.description: A stored layout without its positions, for listing.

id.title: Id
id.description:
Stable identifier that does not depend on which end is listed first.

Returns:
    The two ``device:interface`` ends, sorted and joined with ``--``.

Link.title: Link
Link.description: A physical connection between two device interfaces.

LinksCenter.title: LinksCenter
LinksCenter.description: A neighborhood built around the ends of some links.

MonitoringPosition.title: MonitoringPosition
MonitoringPosition.description: A place measurements are taken from, such as a collector at a hub.

NetworkState.title: NetworkState
NetworkState.description: One snapshot of everything a source monitors.

Notice.title: Notice
Notice.description: One person told, or to be told, about a page.

OnCall.title: OnCall
OnCall.description: Who is on call for every team at a moment, and how to reach them.

Ownership.title: Ownership
Ownership.description:
The team that owns each site, device, and link, by code, name, and
id; anything no route matches is left out.

Page.title: Page
Page.description: A page, as recorded. Nothing is sent.

Paging.title: Paging
Paging.description: Where a page stands at a moment.

PathEnds.title: PathEnds
PathEnds.description: The two devices whose shortest paths are shown.

Person.title: Person
Person.description: Someone who can be on call.

Reachability.title: Reachability
Reachability.description: Round-trip time and loss to a device from one monitoring position.

RoutedProblem.title: RoutedProblem
RoutedProblem.description: A problem, with who owns it and whom it has paged.

RoutedProblemList.title: RoutedProblemList
RoutedProblemList.description: The problems in one snapshot, most urgent first, routed.

Shift.title: Shift
Shift.description: Who is on call for a team over a stretch of time.

Site.title: Site
Site.description: A physical location with map coordinates.

SiteCenter.title: SiteCenter
SiteCenter.description: A neighborhood built around every device of a site.

StateEvent.title: StateEvent
StateEvent.description:
A change a source saw: a device or link going down or coming back,
readings stopping or resuming, packet loss starting or clearing, or a
link's load crossing 80% or 95% (``pct`` is the load after the change).

Step.title: Step
Step.description: One step of escalation: whom to page, so many minutes after the page.

TeamNow.title: TeamNow
TeamNow.description: A team, who is on call for it, and who is on next.

Topology.title: Topology
Topology.description: A whole network: every site, device, and link.

WhatIf.title: WhatIf
WhatIf.description: What failing some items would do, on top of what is already down.

WhatIfQuestion.title: WhatIfQuestion
WhatIfQuestion.description:
Devices, sites, and links to suppose failed, and the moment whose live
state to start from (none for the healthy network).

WindowIn.title: WindowIn
WindowIn.description: A maintenance window as someone plans it.
